purpose: Common-backbone comparison addressing BB-W2 and HH-W3 with a simple control that receives both retrieved action priors and direct retrieved-action conditioning.
reference: New Full run from the same immutable release. The existing Full5 numerical segment may continue only through validated full-state lineage, without resetting its optimizer or dataloader progress.

control.retrieval: Same factual current observations, episode history, original candidate bank, exact coarse top32 pool; coarse top1 chosen without consequence reranking.
control.source: Fixed0.25 prior weight declared in the earlier source-only protocol; common deterministic start-state warp; existing validity/thread guards retained.
control.conditioning: Same eight factual-history gist slots plus four direct retrieved-action slots. Flatten all32x14 normalized warped action values, split into four112-value tokens and pad each to the existing512-wide input. A zero-initialized trainable512-to-text projection adds no lossy pooling or future labels.
control.auxiliary_losses: Removed-module retrieval, effect, gate and adaptation losses are zero; common factual bridge/gist and ActionDiT training remain.
control.attribution: Declared common-backbone control. Not an official ReCAP or informed-source-flow reproduction.

budget.checkpoint_selection: Fixed3000 total updates; DEV reporting only, no TEST selection. Report an incomplete seed plan explicitly.
budget.segment_status: Initial optimization segment toward the fixed3000 checkpoint; not a100-step efficacy baseline.

historical_boundary: The earlier source-only5-update prototype remains engineering evidence. Neither new model replaces the author-designated paper checkpoint or historical paper numbers silently.
resource_policy: One H100. Run memory-intensive training exclusively; use immutable source snapshots and preserve optimizer, scheduler, RNG, data cursor, failures and raw metrics at bounded checkpoints.
